Settings

Progress is saved in this browser only. Export a backup file to keep it safe or move it to another device.

Requires a free Firebase Realtime Database. Set the same Sync Code and Database URL on every device — progress will sync automatically.

Use Force push the first time you set up sync on your main device (the one with your existing progress), so it seeds the cloud. Use Force pull on other devices afterward to bring that progress down. Regular "Sync now" is enough after that.
